map_intro.block.noellesroles.poison_zone: Toxic areas will poison players who enter the area and are suitable for creating dangerous areas or trap areas.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.breaking_br: Broken bridge blocks can be used as bridge deck mechanisms that will break or collapse to create movement risks. Broken bridge blocks will recover after a period of time.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.sabotage_br: It can be triggered by the destruction mission, and the bridge mechanism will be triggered after the destruction mission is started.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.dripping_st: At random intervals, dripping stone cones will fall downwards and kill players standing below.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.fog_zone.de: The fog area is used to partially create fog obstruction, which affects the player's vision. If you stay in the fog for too long, you will die due to disorientation. Perspective instinct cannot be turned on in the fog. Only killer/neutral/specific role can enter.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.manhole.des: Manhole covers can be used as map passages, hidden entrances or fast movement points. If you stay in the manhole cover for too long, you will die of suffocation. Only killers/neutral/specific role can enter.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.cellar.desc: Right-click to open, and the cellar door will automatically close and cannot be opened again for a period of time.
It can be triggered by the sabotage task, it is normally open, and it is closed when the sabotage task is triggered.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.flamethrowe: It can be triggered by destruction missions and used in map mechanisms. It will create dangerous fire areas and burn players to death. It can be triggered by redstone manipulation.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.rolling_sto: It can be triggered by the destruction mission. The rolling stone trigger plate is used to trigger the rolling stone mechanism. After the player steps on it, it summons the rolling stone.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.train_targe: The train target will emit a redstone signal after being shot by a gun.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.incinerator: There is a small ignition zone in front of the incinerator. Pushing the player into the ignition zone will cause the player to die.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.moving_plat: Moving blocks creates a moving platform.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.hurricane_d: The hurricane device is used to create a wind field or storm trap that will pick up and throw the player.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.coffin.desc: When players stay near the coffin for too long, a corpse shell will be summoned to automatically search for nearby adventure mode players. Players touched by the corpse shell will die.
Right-clicking the water pump 5 times will give the player a glass of water.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.trash_can.d: When a player right-clicks the trash can with an item in his hand, the items in his hand will be cleared directly according to the configuration. Creative mode players can configure the destruction whitelist and blacklist by right-clicking with bare hands.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.vending_mac: The vending machine can be configured with goods, and players can interact with it to purchase supplies within the map.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.lottery_mac: The lottery machine can be configured with prize pools and weights to obtain random rewards within the map.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.devil_roule: The roulette table is a special way of playing roulette mode where players can trigger the roulette game around the table.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.repair_hotb: Searchable barrel cabinets are used for loot play, and players can open and obtain the items inside.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.supply_crat: The supply box is used for map supplies and can be configured to generate specific supplies periodically.
Players who hit the kill block die immediately, including water.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.kill_block_: Players who hit the kill block panel will die immediately, including water.
map_intro.block.starrailexpress.train_li: Train lights are invisible or low-presence scene lights that can be affected by redstone and the train lights-off mechanism.
map_intro.block.starrailexpress.remote_r: Wireless redstone can transmit the redstone signal obtained in one place to the bound target for cross-regional linkage.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.trimm: Trimmed lanterns are controllable scene lights suitable for map lighting.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.wall_: Wall lights are wall-mounted scene light sources, suitable for corridor and room lighting.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.neon_: Neon columns are scene blocks that are both decorative and lighting, and can be used for lighting.
Neon tubes are elongated scene lights that can be used for lighting.
map_intro.block.starrailexpress.entity_i: Entity interactive blocks are multifunctional blocks with configurable trigger conditions and trigger content, used to create complex map mechanisms, instructions, transmissions, rewards or status changes.
Entity Interaction Paneling works the same as Entity Interaction Blocks.
map_intro.block.starrailexpress.ticket_o: The ticket office is used for ticketing-related scene interactions. Players can purchase tickets at the ticket office (some tickets have a number of uses).
map_intro.block.starrailexpress.ticket_g: The ticket gate is controlled by the admission ticket. Players can open the ticket gate when holding the corresponding admission ticket. The red stone signal can force the ticket gate to open and can be used as a special area entrance, access control or agency door. (In creative mode, hold the ticket and right-click the ticket gate to bind it)
map_intro.block.starrailexpress.effect_g: The potion effect generator can be configured and given to players in the area with specified potion effects for area buffs, penalties, or special mechanics.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.reactor.des: The reactor device is one of the mission points for the destruction mission, and there may be 1 to 2 locations on the map.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.water_valve: The water valve is one of the task points for dismantling the damage task, and there may be 1 ~ 2 places in the map.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.debris_pile: Debris piles are usually one of the mission points for unblocking sabotage missions, and there may be more than 2 of them on the map.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.scene_stove: The stove is a task point in the heating scene. The player can right-click the stove to light it and stay there for a while to complete the heating task, and the heating value can be restored immediately.
Dust is the task point of cleaning the dust scene. The player holds the vanilla brush and right-clicks the dust to clean it.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.transport_p: Transport points are used for transporting material scene tasks. The green box is the starting point and the red box is the end point.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.scene_statu: The statue is a prayer scene quest point. Players need to look at the statue within six blocks.
Shrubs are task points in pruning shrubs scenes. Players can trim shrubs by right-clicking on them with scissors.
The straw mat is a task point in the activity scene. Players need to jump on the grass mat.
map_intro.block.minecraft.black_concrete: Running on black concrete completes the workout.
map_intro.block.minecraft.note_block.des: The Note Block is one of the regular quest points and is used for playing music quests.
map_intro.block.minecraft.lectern.desc: The podium with the book is one of the regular mission points and is used for reading missions.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.light: The light-colored toilet is one of the regular task points and is used for toilet tasks.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.dark_: The dark toilet is one of the regular mission points and is used for toileting missions.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.white: The white-trimmed bed is one of the regular mission points and is used for sleeping missions.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.red_t: The red-trimmed bed is one of the regular quest points and is used for sleeping quests.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.stain: The stainless steel shower can be used as a bathing mission point and is used in the shower mission area in the map.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.gold_: The golden spray can be used as a bathing task point and used in the showering task area.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.food_: The food plate is one of the regular mission points where players can complete eating missions.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.drink: The drink tray is one of the regular mission points where players can complete the drinking mission.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.camer: Cameras are used for security or surveillance-related arrangements and can be used with the map mechanism to create observation points.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.secur: The monitor is used to view camera footage.
map_intro.block.starrailexpress.minigame: The mini-game mission point block is used to configure mini-game missions, destruction missions or specific role mission points.
Mini game task point panels are small game task points in the form of thin sheets, suitable for wall-mounted or hidden layout.
map_intro.mechanic.tasks.title: Routine tasks and scene tasks
map_intro.mechanic.tasks.body:
Regular missions will appear in all maps, while scenario missions will only appear in specific maps.
Routine tasks include: sleeping, reading, eating, drinking, exercising, meditating, bathing, playing music, going to the toilet, resting on a chair, and being alone
Scenario tasks include: breathing air, keeping warm, cleaning dust, transporting supplies, praying, pruning shrubs, and moving muscles.
Breathe the air: Go and stand where you can see the sky
Warming: right-click to light the stove block and stay next to the stove for a while
Clean dust: Hold the vanilla brush and right-click the dust to clean it
Transporting materials: Pick up materials at the starting point of the transportation point (green box) and deliver them to the end of the transportation point (red box)
Prayer: Look at the statue within six blocks of the statue block
Prune shrubs: right-click the shrub block with scissors
Muscle mobilization: jumping on the grass mat
map_intro.mechanic.status_bar.title: special status bar
map_intro.mechanic.status_bar.body:
Warmth value: When the player is in a position where the sky can be seen, the warmth value decreases by 1 point every 20 seconds (it will accumulate). When the player stands on ice/blue ice/ice floe/snow/snow block, 1 point decreases every 15 seconds (accumulates). When the player is in fine snow, the warmth value decreases by 1 point every 2 seconds. When a player is hit by a snowball, the warmth value is immediately reduced by 2 points. When the player is wearing any piece of leather armor, the warmth value will decrease more slowly. When wearing 3 or more pieces of leather armor, the warmth value will no longer decrease. When the player is indoors (that is, where the sky cannot be seen), the warmth value is restored by 1 point every 10 seconds. When the player is next to the stove task point block in the module, the full warmth value will be restored immediately. When the warmth value reaches zero, the player will freeze to death.
Thirst value: When the player is in a position where the sky can be seen, the thirst value decreases by 1 point every 25 seconds (it will accumulate). When the player consumes physical energy while running, 1 point will decrease (accumulate) every 30 seconds of running. When the player drinks the beverage items in the module, 4 thirst points will be restored. When drinking "a glass of water", 10 thirst points will be restored. When the player is immersed in water, 1 thirst point is restored every 20 seconds. When the thirst value reaches zero, the player will die of thirst.
Hunger value: Every minute and a half of game time, the hunger value decreases by 2 points. When the player consumes energy to run, 2 points will decrease (accumulated) every 20 seconds of running. Hunger points are restored when the player eats. When the hunger value reaches zero, the player will starve to death.
Pollution value: The pollution value is initially 0 and reaches a maximum of 20. The Killer faction role will not have it. When soaked in water, 1 point will be added every 15 seconds (accumulation will occur), and when it rains, 1 point will be added every 8 seconds (accumulation will occur). Decreased by 1 point every 2.5 seconds while standing under the shower head. When the pollution value is full, the mood value will be reduced by 0.05 points per second (until 0), and Slowness 1 and Blindness 2 will be obtained at the same time.
map_intro.mechanic.sabotage.title: sabotage mission
map_intro.mechanic.sabotage.body:
When a map has mini-game missions enabled, there may be sabotage missions in the map for Killers or specific role. Destruction mission points can be seen through the Killer or a specific role mission point perspective. The Killer or a specific role can start the Destruction Mission (complete the mini-game) at the Destruction Mission mission point.
When a sabotage mission is started, an alarm will sound on the map, and the mechanisms triggered by the sabotage mission will be triggered directly. Players need to go to the corresponding "mission point to release the sabotage mission" to proactively release the sabotage mission. The task points for unblocking destruction tasks are usually: reactor core, water valve, and debris pile. There will be 1 to 2 reactor cores/water valves, and there may be more than 2 debris piles. The sabotage mission will only be released when all reactor cores/water valves/trash piles in the map are closed/extinguished.
Penalty for not completing the sabotage mission: If the civilian/non-killer neutral role fails to release the sabotage mission within the specified time, everyone will have their sanity value reduced by half based on the sanity bar, and all items on them will enter a 15-second cooldown.
map_intro.mechanic.conduit_core.title: surge core
map_intro.mechanic.conduit_core.body: Underwater maps usually have a surge core mechanism, and surge energy will provide all players with underwater night vision and underwater breathing abilities. The killer can go to the core of the surge and actively close the core through mechanisms.
map_intro.mechanic.game_currency.title: game currency
map_intro.mechanic.game_currency.body:
There will be 2 types of currency in the game
coin: The most commonly used and common currency that can be used to purchase items in role stores/vending machines, coin is usually obtained by completing tasks/passive income.
Game tokens: You can get 2 game tokens when completing mini-game tasks. Game tokens can be used to purchase items in vending machines/lottery machines (mini-game tasks are only enabled in specific maps)
map_intro.mechanic.train_target.title: train target / target
map_intro.mechanic.train_target.body: Train Target: A redstone mechanism will be triggered when hit by a pistol/sniper rifle. Target: A redstone trap will be triggered when hit by a projectile
map_intro.mechanic.special_roles.title: role for specific map refreshes
map_intro.mechanic.special_roles.body:
The following role will only appear on specific maps
Bag ghost map: Bag ghost, trickster
Big Map: SWAT
Underwater map: Neptune, Water Ghost, Diver
Sky Map: Shadow Falcon, Pilot
Agency Map: Adventurer
Horseback Riding Map: Horse Trainer, Hunter
Conference Map: Canada Goose
Meeting Voting Map: Slowpoke, Politician, Preacher
